interlocks.cause: Guard door opened / not closed (ZS-3002 / X32 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Immediately de-energise / inhibit HiPot start/HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain not healthy / lost (ES-0001 / X0 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Immediately de-energise / inhibit HiPot start/HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: Test result latched (PASS M310 ON or FAIL M311 ON)
interlocks.effect: De-energise / inhibit HiPot start/HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: Pallet not in ST30 position (ZS-3001 / X33 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibit HiPot start/HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

steps.entry: Initial state or pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33 resets PASS M310 and FAIL M311)
steps.exit: Pallet in position (ZS-3001 / X33), guard door closed (ZS-3002 / X32), E-stop healthy (ES-0001 / X0), and neither PASS (M310) nor FAIL (M311) latched
steps.name: Idle

steps.entry: Pallet in position (ZS-3001 / X33), guard door closed (ZS-3002 / X32), E-stop healthy (ES-0001 / X0), and neither result latched (ANI M310, ANI M311); turns ON HiPot start/HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)
steps.exit: Tester reports PASS (HP-3003 / X30) or FAIL (HP-3004 / X31), guard door opens (ZS-3002 / X32 lost), or E-stop lost (ES-0001 / X0 lost)
steps.name: HV Test

steps.entry: Tester PASS (HP-3003 / X30 sets M310) or FAIL (HP-3004 / X31 sets M311); turns OFF HiPot start/HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)
steps.exit: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33 resets M310 and M311)
steps.name: Result Latched
